claims.scope: exploratory single predesignated E1 seed11 matched pair
claims.label_source: idealized analytical solution; no field observations
claims.held_out: solution labels only; PDE collocation covers the full 0<t<0.5 s domain
claims.checkpoint_selection: minimum separate physics/IC/BC validation with fixed 1/10/10 weights, including step zero; earliest strict improvement
claims.data_validation: post-fit diagnostic only; never fit, select checkpoints or tune settings
